statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with clinical presentation over an extended period
Diagnosis codes I25.10 and R00.2 were used
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring via CPT 93247 is clinically indicated and medically necessary
